decks.notes: This control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with removal, counterspells, and resource denial while also generating card advantage and outvaluing them in the late game. The deck aims to control the board with a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures like The Wandering Emperor and Sunfall. It also utilizes card draw and token generation engines like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Caretaker's Talent to maintain card advantage and board presence. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while also providing utility lands for additional value.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early creature aggression and burn spells to quickly defeat the opponent. With a low mana curve and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, combined with direct damage spells like Monstrous Rage and Reckless Rage, this deck aims to push the opponent on the back foot from the beginning of the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and flexibility in the deck construction. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, unrelenting attacks and burn damage.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently. By combining low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero with powerful spells like Monstrous Rage and Titan's Strength, the goal is to deal large amounts of damage early on in the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck's strategy. With a strong mana base and a mix of burn spells and creature buffs, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to win through fast, relentless aggression.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to disrupt and control the opponent's board while setting up a win condition through card advantage and tempo plays. Cards like Dovin's Veto, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and Settle the Wreckage are used to counter threats and maintain board control, while Memory Deluge and March of Otherworldly Light provide card advantage. The deck also utilizes a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, for additional synergies and consistency. Overall, the deck aims to out-value and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on aggressively and efficiently eliminating opponent's threats while applying pressure with evasive creatures and burn spells. The key is to disrupt opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while clearing the way for your creatures with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Kroxa and Archfiend of the Dross to maintain card advantage and pressure the opponent's life total. Overall, the deck aims to close out games quickly through a combination of disruption, removal, and efficient threats.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay to overwhelm opponents quickly. The main strategy is to use low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, combined with powerful instant spells like Titan's Strength and Fatal Push, to deal damage efficiently. The deck also includes cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Callous Sell-Sword for additional power and versatility. By utilizing the aggressive nature of the Rakdos color combination, this deck aims to establish board control early and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively playing creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Monastery Swiftspear to deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Monstrous Rage and Titan's Strength, the deck aims to pump up its creatures and push through damage efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck. With a mix of burn spells like Fatal Push and Claim / Fame, along with land cards like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creatures.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast, aggressive creatures and powerful support cards. This deck aims to quickly fill the board with creatures like Resplendent Angel, Righteous Valkyrie, and Skyclave Apparition, while also utilizing cards like Kayla's Reconstruction and Giada, Font of Hope to create a strong board presence. Collected Company allows for explosive plays, while cards like Bishop of Wings provide additional value. By combining quick mana ramp with efficient threats, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and secure victories through aggressive gameplay.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board presence with aggressive creatures like Bishop of Wings, Giada, Font of Hope, and Righteous Valkyrie. The deck also utilizes mana ramp with cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to cast powerful spells like Collected Company and Kayla's Reconstruction. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats while utilizing cards like Skyclave Apparition and Resplendent Angel to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base includes dual lands like Branchloft Pathway and Razorverge Thicket to ensure consistent access to all necessary colors.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures on the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent with early game pressure. With a combination of efficient creatures like Elite Spellbinder and Anointed Peacekeeper, and powerful spells like Collected Company, the goal is to maintain a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria provide additional disruption by taxing the opponent's spells, giving the deck an edge in tempo. The mana base is designed to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for the deck's spells and creatures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Duress. The key strategy revolves around quickly overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester, while also maintaining board control with removal spells like Go for the Throat. The deck also utilizes mana-efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to pressure the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to close out games quickly through a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The main focus of this deck is to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy using Azorius-colored Spirits. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller, along with disruption spells such as Portable Hole and Get Lost, the deck aims to control the board while putting pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Supreme Phantom and Skyclave Apparition help to enhance the tempo of the deck, allowing for quick and efficient attacks. Wedding Announcement also provides a way to generate additional Spirit tokens, further strengthening the aggro game plan.

The deck focuses on deploying low-cost spirit creatures quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal spells, and bounce effects. The key strategy is to maintain tempo by efficiently controlling the board and pressuring the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck's synergy lies in its ability to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's plays, allowing for a swift victory through efficient aggression and disruption.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with low-cost creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to attack aggressively with cards like Emberheart Challenger and Monastery Swiftspear, while also using burn spells like Ancestral Anger and Heartfire Hero to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of creature attacks and direct damage spells.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Bishop of Wings and Resplendent Angel, while also utilizing mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to ramp into powerful spells like Collected Company. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and synergy between angel creatures like Righteous Valkyrie and Giada, Font of Hope. With a mix of removal in Skyclave Apparition and pump effects from cards like Kayla's Reconstruction, this deck is designed to be fast and consistent in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on using cheap creatures and pump spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to play creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero early on and use spells like Titan's Strength and Might of the Meek to make them bigger and hit harder. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana flexibility. Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance offer extra reach, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage help clear the way for attacks.
